promotion_line.speaker: idit
promotion_line.text: Third star. Nobody said promotion — they handed him a wider map and a longer list of towns.

promotion_line.speaker: idit
promotion_line.text: Fourth star. The north has not been shelled in two days and he has not mentioned it once.

promotion_line.speaker: shai
promotion_line.text: Five. They are giving me the brigade because the corridor is cut, and it is cut because you kept off the village.

lines.at_large: The digger. Four years under the Marj, and still under it.
lines.captured: Taken at the shaft head with his hands empty.
lines.killed: Killed at the shaft head. The routes were his; so was the map of them.

lines.at_large: He has never fired at us. He has seen every round that came back.
lines.captured: Taken on the crest. He gave us the road before he gave us his name.
lines.killed: Off the crest, with the basin still in front of him.

lines.at_large: Everything under the Marj and over Sur came up his road.
lines.captured: Taken at his own gate. He asks what happens to the road.
lines.killed: Dead at the gate he would not leave.
